name: DC-005 OC-001 — Manual Operations Controller
description: DC-005-OC-001: manual-trigger n8n workflow that starts one approved DC-003 Engineering Work Order through the existing Operations Bridge (npm run operations-bridge -- run ... --json, DC-003-I029.4/I029.4.1) and routes the already-decided outcome to the CEO. n8n owns no eligibility, engineering, Git, locking, review, authority, persistence or decision logic — all of that remains inside DC-003. Mock mode only (default mock Delivery Office runner + default mock Strategy Review adapter) — no --live-runner/--live-review flag exists anywhere in this workflow, so live execution cannot be accidentally enabled. NOT YET IMPORTED OR EXECUTED as of authoring: n8n MCP was unavailable and the n8n-test container's own DC-003 repository mount (/data/dc003-repo, read-only) is currently checked out to a different branch (dc-004/i001-industry-library-structure) that does not contain commit 4ca2429 or the operations-bridge.mjs CLI this workflow depends on — see the DC-005 OC-001 documentation in this same project folder for the exact blocker and manual import steps once resolved.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { outcome: "input_error", work_order_id: $json.work_order_id, safeErrorSummary: "work_order_id is missing or does not match the required form wo_<alphanumeric> — the Operations Bridge was never invoked.", suggestedSafeAction: "Correct the work_order_id in the Build Work Order Input node and re-run." } }}

parameters.command:
=RUN_DIR=/tmp/dc005-oc001-run-{{ $now.toFormat('yyyyLLdd-HHmmssSSS') }}
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
cd /data/dc003-repo
node tests/validation/operations-bridge.mjs run \
  "{{ $json.work_order_id }}" \
  /home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/work-orders \
  /home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/delivery-reports \
  /home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/strategy-reviews \
  /home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/bridge \
  /data/dc003-repo \
  --repo=/data/dc003-repo \
  --delivery-lock=/home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/locks/delivery \
  --review-lock=/home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/locks/review \
  --drop=/home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/drop \
  --export=/home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/export \
  --json > "$RUN_DIR/stdout.json" 2> "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log"
DC005_EXIT_CODE=$?
cat "$RUN_DIR/stdout.json"
echo "DC005_EXIT_CODE=$DC005_EXIT_CODE"
cat "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log" 1>&2

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { outcome: "approved", workOrderId: $json.workOrderId, workOrderTitle: $json.workOrderTitle, deliveryReportId: $json.deliveryReportId, deliveryCommit: $json.deliveryCommit, strategyReviewId: $json.strategyReviewId, summary: $json.summary, status: "completed" } }}

={{ { outcome: "correction_required", workOrderId: $json.workOrderId, deliveryStatus: $json.deliveryStatus, strategyReviewId: $json.strategyReviewId, summary: $json.summary, requiredOutcome: $json.correction ? $json.correction.required_outcome : null, verificationRequired: $json.correction ? $json.correction.verification_required : null, risks: $json.risks || [] } }}

={{ { outcome: "ceo_decision_required", workOrderId: $json.workOrderId, summary: $json.summary, decisionRequired: $json.ceoEscalation ? $json.ceoEscalation.decision_required : null, reason: $json.ceoEscalation ? $json.ceoEscalation.reason : null, safeOptions: $json.ceoEscalation ? $json.ceoEscalation.safe_options : [], defaultSafeAction: "stop", risks: $json.risks || [] } }}

={{ { outcome: "technical_failure", workOrderId: $json.workOrderId, safeErrorSummary: $json.parseError || ($json.error ? $json.error.message : "Operations Bridge did not produce a decodable result."), exitCode: $json.exitCode, validJsonResultProduced: $json.validJsonResultProduced, suggestedSafeAction: "Inspect the run directly (exit code / stderr) - do not rerun blindly." } }}

parameters.content:
## DC-005 OC-001 — Manual Operations Controller

Manual Trigger -> Build Work Order Input -> Validate Work Order Input -> Run Operations Bridge (one Execute Command call, --json) -> Parse Operations Bridge Result -> Route Outcome -> Prepare {Approved / Correction Required / CEO Decision Required / Rejected / Technical Failure} Output.

Invokes DC-003-I029.4/I029.4.1's `operations-bridge.mjs run ... --json` CLI unchanged, exactly once, against the repo read-only bind-mounted at /data/dc003-repo. n8n owns zero eligibility/engineering/Git/locking/review/authority/persistence/decision logic - DC-003 already decided everything before this workflow ever sees a result; this workflow only starts it and presents what DC-003 already decided.

Mock mode only: default mock Delivery Office runner + default mock Strategy Review adapter. No --live-runner/--live-review flag exists anywhere in this workflow - live execution cannot be accidentally enabled from here.

Persistent storage (inside the durable n8n_data volume, survives container recreation, outside the read-only repo mount, never committed to Git): /home/node/.n8n/dc003/engineering/{work-orders,delivery-reports,strategy-reviews,bridge,locks/delivery,locks/review,drop,export} - created automatically on first write by the same store adapters every other DC-003 milestone already uses; nothing here pre-creates them.

NOT YET IMPORTED OR EXECUTED - see DC-005 OC-001 documentation in this project folder for the exact blocker (the container's own DC-003 mount is currently on a different branch, not main) and manual import steps.
